name: Crate of Inn Supplies
summary: In Coldridge Valley, travelers are needed to carry the Crate of Inn Supplies to Kharanos. Troggs have closed the mountain pass, leaving the Thunderbrew Distillery dependent on their help.

sections.title: Through the Trogg Pass
sections.body: Near Anvilmar, the Crate of Inn Supplies waits for a safe passage through Coldridge Pass. Troggs have cut off the route, keeping civilian couriers from carrying goods until the Mountaineers clear the road. Hands Springsprocket packed tavern provisions for Tannok Frosthammer in Kharanos, where the supplies are needed.

faq.answer: The crate holds general tavern supplies for the inn in Kharanos, where travelers and locals seek warmth.

faq.q: Who sends the crate to Kharanos?
faq.answer: Hands Springsprocket packs the crate near Anvilmar and asks travelers leaving Coldridge Valley to carry it through the mountain pass.

faq.q: Why couldn't the normal courier deliver it?
faq.answer: Troggs have overrun Coldridge Pass, making it too dangerous for ordinary couriers without Mountaineer escorts. Travelers who can fight through are the inn's immediate hope of receiving the supplies.
Tannok Frosthammer, the innkeeper's assistant at the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos, receives the parcel.

angles.text: As a young dwarf, carrying these supplies is your first service beyond Coldridge Valley. You brave the trogg-choked pass to help your kin in Kharanos.
As a newly arrived gnome, carrying Hands Springsprocket's package is a practical way to earn goodwill among the local dwarves who run Dun Morogh's inns.
